contract.problem: Smooth periodic 3D Euler entropy wave; gamma=2, pressure=1, velocity=(0.5,0.2,-0.1)
contract.primary_error: volume-weighted L1 density error against analytic cell averages; absolute nondimensional units
contract.additional_errors: componentwise L1/Linf errors; pressure and velocity drift; conserved-total drift
contract.timing: initial-condition construction, timestep selection, all stages/steps, per-step admissibility checks, and returned solution; final analytic error analysis timed separately
contract.selection: minimum declared cell-stage work among sampled grids satisfying the same error/admissibility contract; report fastest sampled wall time separately
contract.work_units: cell-stage updates, with EOS cell evaluations counted separately; neither is a scalar-FLOP or hardware model
contract.scope: Exact smooth solution of the stated PDE; not experimental physical validation, shocks, general Euler convergence, or global solver optimality

scope: Measured work to an analytic Euler solution error on a finite test catalogue; no global optimality claim
